models.about: Each pixel is a parameter t of this curve, coloured by the fate of the free critical point ω′ (the marked one is in the Julia set). Phase colours: landing discs |ρ| < 1, where ω′ is attracted to the landing cycle; grey: another attracting cycle. models.title: PrePer<sub>3,3</sub>
models.normal: Remark: it’s the same torus as Per5! f(z) = 1 + b/z + a/z2, u on the Per_5 torus: X = ℘(u), x = −X − 5/4, s = 1/x, v = ℘′(u) s2, a = (2s2 + 5s + 2 + v)/(2s), b = s − a: marked critical point ω = 0 → ∞ → 1 → …, first periodic at w3, period 3; free critical point ω′ = −2a/b.
models.about: Each pixel is a parameter t of this curve, coloured by the fate of the free critical point ω′ (the marked one is in the Julia set). Special points and punctures from preper_build.py (exact equations, puncture = fixed-point multipliers unbounded).  PrePer<sub>3,3</sub> is birational over Q to the Per<sub>5</sub> elliptic curve w<sup>2</sup> = 4X<sup>3</sup> − (11/4)X + 3/8 (lines a + b = s through its one singular point [1 : −1 : 0]); so it is drawn on the same flat torus (dashed seams: the period rectangle; real circles Im u = 0 and Im u = W<sub>2</sub>/2). Census: preper33_build.py, preper33_locate.js.

models.title: The symmetry locus
models.normal: f(z) = k(z + 1/z), which commutes with z ↦ −z; critical points ±1. Its quotient by the symmetry, w = z², is g(w) = k²(w + 2 + 1/w): the point PrePer<sub>2,1</sub> at t = k² (a 2:1 cover k ↦ k²). ±i → 0 → ∞ (fixed): ∞ plays the landing fixed point.
models.about: Each pixel is a parameter k, colored by the fate of the critical points ±1 (by the symmetry they share it), exactly as PrePer<sub>2,1</sub> colors t = k²: phase colors when they are attracted to the fixed point ∞ (|k| > 1), grey for another attracting cycle. The picture is the PrePer<sub>2,1</sub> picture pulled back by k ↦ k².

info.tiling: No tiling: the k-plane, a 2:1 cover of the PrePer<sub>2,1</sub> parameter plane.
